longDescription: Bring your team’s tasks, knowledge, and working instructions into the AI assistant you already use. Find shared tasks, review progress and evidence, and read results in your Tedix organization. With the permissions you grant, ask a tedi for help and save results for your team.
defaultPrompt: Find the Work Item for my current task.
Summarize the status and evidence for a Work Item.
Read the latest output in my Tedix workspace.
